Author: Tamamura H, Murakami T, Horiuchi S, Sugihara K, Otaka A, Takada W, Ibuka T, Waki M, Yamamoto N, Fujii N.
Comments: The sequence of IB-367 is RGGLCYCRGRFCVCVGR and the peptide is active against bacteria and fungi. This peptide showed synergistic effect with LL-37 against P. aeruginosa and E. coli (Yan H & Hancock REW 2001 Antimicrob Agents Chemother 45: 1558-60). PG-1 derivatives were subjected to clinical trials.
